lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters posterior to the gills, forming approximately 10-12 discernible vertical columns and 4-5 horizontal rows along the visible mid-section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect horizontal rows of spots, creating a grid-like pattern where spots serve as high-luminance nodes, particularly visible in the central flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features running along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from light dorsal edges to shadowed ventral edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs bounded within the first dorsal fin silhouette, with higher density observed toward the leading edge and base.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant diagonal light-ray artifacts (caustics) originating from the upper-right quadrant, creating high-frequency luminance noise across the posterior flank and caudal region.
